script:
if doc.mobile_no:
    existing = frappe.db.get_value(
        "CRM Lead",
        {"mobile_no": doc.mobile_no, "name": ["!=", doc.name]},
        ["name", "lead_name", "status"],
        as_dict=True,
    )
    if existing:
        frappe.throw(
            f"A lead with mobile {doc.mobile_no} already exists: "
            f"{existing.lead_name} ({existing.name}) — Stage: {existing.status}. "
            "Use the Reactivation flow if the lead is Cold or Archived.",
            title="Duplicate Mobile Number",
        )
